text: The code printed it: inventory.csv holds 30 rows across 12 columns. sku is the part number, category the kind of part, supplier who it comes from and warehouse where it sits. on_hand is the count in stock and reserved the part of that already spoken for; reorder_point is the level at which it should be reordered and unit_cost what one costs. last_counted is the date of the last stock count, discontinued a yes/no, lead_time_days how long a replacement takes to arrive, and notes a free-text field that is empty for most rows.
